description.value: Simplex Sportszone is a large indoor sports simulation centre in Kelowna's Enterprise Way commercial district, offering over 400 virtual golf courses via Trackman 4, a full suite of multi-sport simulators (baseball, hockey, soccer, and more), and six full-motion 5DOF racing cockpits under the RaceZone brand. The facility is licensed, family-friendly, and caters to groups of up to 40 people with deli food and event packages. It could serve as a rainy-day or rest-day diversion for touring cyclists exploring the Kelowna area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active indoor sports simulation venue in Kelowna offering Trackman golf, multi-sport simulators, and full-motion racing cockpits. Contact details on the website (#200-2600 Enterprise Way, phone (778) 699-2072) corroborate the OSM address; OSM carried no phone. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site, though deli food and snacks are explicitly noted.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (778) 699-2072 sourced from website only.
OSM address omits unit number; website specifies #200-2600 Enterprise Way.
No cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving all required criteria as null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Simplex Sportszone is a legitimate, active business but is an indoor simulation venue with no confirmed cycling-specific amenities; its value to touring cyclists is as a discretionary rainy-day attraction rather than a practical cycling service stop, and none of the three required criteria could be confirmed.
enrichment_extras.notes: Registered business name of Kelowna CartsPlus Ltd., per website footer.

Café or food on site.detail: Website states the facility is "licensed, offering deli food, snacks, and catered options."

wow_evidence: Commercial simulator entertainment centre; no independent story.
